nodes.question: What is the main focus of the special issue titled "Challenges and Recent Advancements in Nuclear Energy Systems"?
nodes.answer: The special issue focuses on studies, insights, and innovations related to the growth of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes, particularly in the context of Saudi Arabia’s nuclear initiatives and aspirations.
nodes.paragraph: Arabian Journal for Science and Engineering (2025) 50:2945 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13369-25-10023-1 EDITORIAL Concluding Preface Afaque Shams1 Khaled Al-Athel1 Iztok Tiselj2 Bojan Ni ceno3 Ihsan ulhaq Toor1 Published online: 20 February 2025 King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals 2025 The rapidly evolving energy landscape demands sustainable, ef cient, and environmentally responsible solutions to meet the growing global energy needs. Nuclear energy, with itspotential to provide reliable and clean energy, remains acornerstone of this transformation. This is particularly sig- ni cant for Saudi Arabia, where Vision 2030 emphasizes the strategic development of nuclear energy to diversify itsenergy portfolio, enhance energy security, and establish the Kingdom as a leader in innovative energy technologies. This special issue, Challenges and Recent Advancements in Nuclear Energy Systems has brought together an array of studies, insights, and innovations that address critical aspects of the growth of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes. Itserves as a comprehensive resource, covering a wide range oftopics essential for advancing nuclear energy systems, with a particular focus on their relevance to Saudi Arabia S nuclear ambitions. Key contributions in this issue explore Saudi Arabia S nuclear initiatives, offering an overview of the Kingdom S roadmap toward becoming the Middle East S largest producerof nuclear energy.

nodes.question: Why is interest in renewable energy storage devices increasing?
nodes.answer: Interest is increasing due to the dependence on non-renewable fossil fuels and the need for environmentally friendly, high-performance energy storage solutions.
nodes.paragraph: It also exhibited a capacity retention of up to 89.72% over 1000 cycles. Keywords Microalgae Pyrolysis lodine and sulphur doping Hydrothermal heating Supercapacitor 1 Introduction Energy, which is vital for world life, seriously affects the economies and the environment of countries around the world due to the current dependence on non-renewable fos- sil fuels [1]. Interest in renewable, environmentally friendly, high-performance energy storage devices such as batteries, supercapacitors and fuel cells for electrochemical energy, which is an important part of clean energy, tends to increase [2, 3]. Among these, supercapacitors, in particular, have gar - nered significant interest from researchers [4 6]. The excellent microstructure and reasonable pore size dis- tribution of biomass-derived carbon materials enable their use in various applications. In particular, the outstanding charge storage/release capacity and high cycling stability of carbon-based supercapacitors promote their applications in energy storage and conversion [7 ]. The development of low- cost and renewable biomass-based carbon materials for use in energy storage devices is an important issue. As typical electrode material for supercapacitors, biomass-based car - bon precursors are attracting intense interest as a reliable and readily available source [8 12].

nodes.paragraph: However, many of these materials contain toxic and costly elements, which limit their usage on a large scale. 13 To address this problem, scientists have been searching for thermoelectric materi- als that are abundant, low-cost, and nontoxic. 13 The efforts in this research direction have resulted in the discovery of promising candidates such as Al-Fe-Si,14 Fe-V-Al,15,16 and Cu-S.17 In particular, due to the presence of the pseudo-gap, the Fe-V-AI alloy18 is considered a very promising thermo- electric material, with a power factor of 55 10 4 W/m K2 at room temperature.
